_why: Runway prompts for the three CJ US-warehouse products created 2026-09-01. Written after LOOKING at each CJ reference image, per the house rule that describing from the product NAME produces plausible-but-wrong goods (the five-finger glove and the quilted sofa cover). Generation was blocked because the Runway connector was disconnected; reconnect it and run these, master first.
_house_style: Every product on the brand cream #F7F2E9, seamless studio sweep, soft even light, gentle contact shadow, product centred and filling roughly 70 percent of frame, square 1:1, photographic not illustrative.
_no_props_clause: No props, no display stands, no packaging, no boxes, no text, no logos, no embossed branding, no watermarks, no hands, no people or animals unless the shot is explicitly a lifestyle shot. Nothing in frame but the product and its shadow.
_model: nano-banana-2 for all of these. None carries label text, so nano-banana-pro is not needed.
_order: Shoot the MASTER first, approve it, then recolour THE APPROVED MASTER for each remaining colour. Recolouring the master is the only way to keep the pose locked across swatches.
_qc: Eyeball every output against the CJ reference in scratchpad/ref/ before upload. Check specifically: the halo collar must have ONE continuous light strip and a black side-release buckle plus a metal D-ring; the bowl must have TWO ear-shaped tabs on the rim and a raised sunburst pattern in the base; the tracker must be a rounded rectangle with side clips, not a round tag.

wagvive-led-safety-halo-collar.master_prompt: Studio product photograph of a single dog collar lying on a seamless cream #F7F2E9 background. The collar is bright blue flat nylon webbing about 2.5 cm wide, laid in a relaxed open loop. Running down the exact centre of the webbing for its whole length is a narrow translucent light-guide strip in a paler blue, slightly glossy, clearly a separate inset band. Fitted to the strap: a matte black plastic side-release buckle, a matte black plastic slider adjuster, and a small brushed silver metal D-ring. Soft even studio light from above, gentle contact shadow beneath, product centred and filling about 70 percent of the square frame, sharp focus, photographic realism. No props, no display stand, no packaging, no text, no logos, no embossed branding, no hands, no dog. Nothing in frame but the collar and its shadow.
